title: More realistic furnace
description: Would you like more realistic smelting, so that items take longer to melt and have a more realistic sense of volume? Then this datapack is for you!
body:
Would you like more realistic smelting, so that items take longer to melt and have a more realistic sense of volume? Then this datapack is for you! It will allow items to take longer to fry, and new smelting items have been added:
all types of coral,
podzol,
mycelium,
grass soil, dirt,
ore blocks,
seagrass,
a bucket of water,
diamond and netherite tools and armor,
stone tools,
wooden items,
leather armor, and leather.
